findings.issue: Beijing bourse headline (n0236) generalised to the whole onshore equity market; 'in October' added to the profits headline (n0224) though the headline names no month.
findings.resolution: Scoped the claim to parts of the market and to downside at the margin; removed the month.

findings.issue: Overstatements beyond headline: 'every dollar' of Nvidia revenue is capex, farm equipment 'first' capex category to guide down, KBW list read as deposit-cost consolidation, Tom's Hardware revenue crown called a profit pool.
findings.resolution: Softened to what the headlines establish (much of, a large category, live path, revenue pool).

findings.issue: Target (n0812) credited to margins; headline supports only an earnings beat with falling sales.
findings.resolution: Reworded to earnings beat outrunning a sales decline.

findings.issue: 'Arbitrage capital is buying the trust' is an unsupported flow claim from the GBTC discount headline (n0779).
findings.resolution: Rephrased as the market increasingly pricing a spot-ETF conversion.

findings.issue: FT headline (n0981) read as EM easing cycles ahead of developed ones; HYG/LQD price returns described as spreads tightening.
findings.resolution: Removed the easing claim, made EM transmission modal, described high yield as joining the rally.

findings.issue: Unsupported thesis details: sovereign-AI demand, Lilly new capacity, Marvell enterprise/carrier weakness and market selling of beats, Alibaba restructuring losing momentum.
findings.resolution: Replaced with claims supported by the cited headlines and card figures.

findings.issue: Timestamp caveat checked for every record stamped 2023-11-26/27 (n0098, n0155, n0679, n0932, n1050, n1626 and others); all describe events plausibly complete before 00:00 UTC (Monday session/US daytime, Asian and European morning items, n1050 stamped 19:22 UTC). n0679 (court ruling) and n0155 (AP market wrap) are the latest-plausible items.
findings.resolution: Retained; no cited record reports Australian retail sales or any 2023-11-28 release. No unsafe feed ids found.

scope_limits: Reviewed only 2023-11-28 feed headlines, card and exclusions; headline-level support only, article bodies not available; no web or later-date material used.
